description: Draft 2020-12 provides structural validation. Conforming processors must also apply the required tldw semantic vocabulary.

x-tldw-profile-semantics.description: Required semantic rules evaluated after structural Draft 2020-12 validation.

canonicalDateTime.description: Aware timestamps are limited to years 0001-9999, whole-minute offsets, and millisecond precision, then rendered in UTC as YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS.sssZ before JCS serialization.

canonicalPayloadMaxUtf8Bytes.description: Maximum UTF-8 bytes of the canonical typed payload after schema_version and kind defaults are applied.

canonicalization.description: Canonical JSON uses RFC 8785 JCS as published at https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc8785.

iJsonMaxSafeInteger.description: Mutable integer counters stay within the exact interoperable I-JSON range.

pendingProposalExpiryDays.description: Pending proposal expires_at must equal created_at plus exactly 90 days.

proposalIdentityAndVersionLinks.description: Nested profile and scope IDs equal the proposal; update record and parent IDs equal target and base IDs; create parent is null.

timestampInvariants.description: Manifest, scope, and record updates do not precede creation; record expiry follows update; proposal expiry follows creation; and all nested proposed records satisfy the same record rules.
